text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Gran Alegria and the others are going to appear
on Loves Only You's stream today.
Curious, I take out my phone—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, for our first segment!
First, we'll have all our guests answer
a rapid-fire Q&A survey~♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Through this, I hope everyone
gets to know more about my friend♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first question!
To put it simply, "When you think of Tracen Academy"—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Its 'history', perhaps... Since so many Umamusume
who achieved great feats have come from here."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "I believe it is 'affection'. Everyone is so kindhearted, and I wish to live up to that."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's so like the two of you! What about you, Gran-chan?
"When you think of Tracen Academy—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Of course, "Salad"!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Salad!? I knew you liked it, but...
Fufu. Gran-chan, you really are so interesting!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘What do you put on your fried eggs?’
Chrono-chan and Bouquet-chan said ‘soy sauce,’ but Gran-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Dressing”, I'd say!
Ah, the onion kind, specifically!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "What do you do when you get nervous?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Slicing the Earth into cross-sections in my head"!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "If you could have any pet, what would you get?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Camel"!!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't she hilarious?"
"Her sense of humor is so unique." "It's getting addicting."
"Gran-chan, look over here!"
choice_data_list: Oh... This is getting exciting in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's move on to the next segment!
The listeners' advice corner!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"First up is... from 'Lightly Carbonated'-san!
'I have a girlfriend I've been dating for 2 years,
and I'm thinking of proposing to her soon.'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... I just can't work up the courage...!"
I see, that really is pretty tough~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You're right... But being able to open up and
consult someone about your worries like this is already admirable in itself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...! Someone like you surely would—
Though that might be irresponsible of me to say..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: What do you think? How about you, Gran-chan?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a proposal, huh... I can't even imagine it myself,
but I can tell it's a huge life decision.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If there's
anything I can say, it would be—
In complete contrast to the mood from moments ago, Gran Alegria's expression turned entirely serious.

It might still be a difficult concept for her...
Even so—she can do it. She can definitely give someone that push forward—!
choice_data_list: Go, Gran! In your own words—
Do your best, Gran! In your own words—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: You are a streetlight!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: S-Streetlights, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yep! So as long as you know how to shine,
a proposal is a piece of cake☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because you've got a light bulb that can
illuminate the whole city!"

Comments flooded in like a waterfall of "???"
Her sensibilities were far too unique... and yet――
choice_data_list: I don't really get it, but words really do have power, huh!
I don't really get it, but maybe words do have power!

text_block_list.text:
And so,
Gran Alegria's life counseling session continued—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: In other words, all roads lead to the Mile! So everyone—become a miler!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I will" "Mile by mile~♪"
"Gotta support her now" "God-tier stream"
"Gave me so much courage, thank you"
choice_data_list: Before you know it, you're energizing everyone!

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was because her words held no deceit.
Gran Alegria's advice seemed to truly resonate with those watching the stream—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! How was it!?
Did you watch today's stream?
choice_data_list: You were quick to respond to the comments, huh.
You were quick to respond to the comments, weren't you.
Of course! It was a blast!
Of course! That was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! How was it!?
Did you watch today's stream?
choice_data_list: You were quick to respond to the comments, huh.
You were quick to respond to the comments, weren't you.
Of course! It was a blast!
Of course! That was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Honestly,
I was just saying what was on my mind, though.
choice_data_list: I think you're really cut out for streaming!
I bet you'd be really good at streaming!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, yay♪
I got praised."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"To even be a natural at streaming,
that's our girl for you! Eheh☆"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Love-chan is amazing after all! She put so much thought into making sure the listeners wouldn't get bored!
choice_data_list: I think Gran contributed quite a lot too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? In that case, I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That stream was so fun. Like 80 miles of fun☆
I wanna be on it again~, ehehe.
